limitations: The additive model permits compensation across criteria; keep hard gates outside the score.
Input intervals are combined as simultaneous criterion-wise bounds and are not calibrated probability intervals.
Weight sensitivity changes one weight at a time and does not cover all plausible weights, criterion dependence, scale uncertainty, or model-form uncertainty.
Ratings and weights are judgments, not empirical measurements of scientific truth.
